name: digital-globe-4k
description: 4K digital globe / binary data-sphere loop built with Remotion

scripts.render:4k: remotion render GlobeViolet4K out/globe-violet-4k.mp4 && remotion render GlobeDarkBlue4K out/globe-darkblue-4k.mp4
scripts.render:1080: remotion render GlobeViolet1080 out/globe-violet-1080p.mp4 && remotion render GlobeDarkBlue1080 out/globe-darkblue-1080p.mp4
